transport.determinism: Exact replay of one request against the same declared initial conditions MUST produce an identical canonical response.
transport.framing: one UTF-8 JSON object on stdin; one UTF-8 JSON object on stdout
transport.process_exit: zero for a well-formed response; non-zero for transport or adapter failure
transport.session: Adapters MUST support describe, execute_case and execute_cases. Batched execution reduces process-startup coupling but does not replace single-case execution.
transport.timeout_policy: The external runner MUST impose a finite timeout and classify timeout as adapter failure.

verdict_authority: The external conformance runner, not the implementation adapter, determines PASS or FAIL.
